B3_F.definition: PREREG_REWARD_2_AMENDMENT_1: launch speed >= 1.0 m/s AND no lead/conflict agent at the logged ego poses of the 17-cycle window (log only, before any rollout)

B3_F_rollout_any_rung.definition: launch speed >= 1.0 m/s AND no lead/conflict agent in any cycle of any of the six rungs. NOT pre-simulation; never decides a section 4 branch

B5_cost.note: single_worker/eff12 follow the PREREG_M_GYM_1 definition: scene+map build + proposals + 24 arms x {log, idm}; regression policies and the ladder are extra
